help:
Usage: mkdir [-p] [-m MODE] [-v] DIRECTORY...
{{help:help:0}}
{{help:version:0}}
MODE accepts octal or symbolic permissions (rwxXst, copied classes and comma clauses).
Sticky-only +t yields 1755 on Linux and 1777 on macOS; a=rwx,+t yields 1777.
Omitted-who expressions requiring the process umask are unavailable.
New POSIX parents failing public write/search checks cause status 2; created parents remain.
Passing access checks does not establish GNU parent-mode parity under restrictive umasks or ACLs.
Windows explicit modes reject before creation; -p existing directories remain no-ops.
Ordinary option/operand errors exit 1; capability refusals exit 2.

options.name: mode
options.description: Set the leaf mode, numeric or supported symbolic.
